result.scope: tiny temporary WAL SQLite tables and one JSON file only; no research archival

limitations: Requires a new destination and completed source stages; a failed new archive is retained with an incomplete marker and cannot be silently overwritten.
SQLite archives preserve every schema/table row through a read-only consistent snapshot, not byte identity to the original database file.
Selected operational logs may continue appending; each copied prefix has timestamps, size and SHA-256. Scientific files require no change during copy.
Only the new V3 inventory is created. Updating the cumulative global inventory and publishing/remote verification remain the supervising task.
